# Behriz Mobadel

> Behriz Mobadel is an Iranian designer and manufacturer of filtration systems and process equipment for the food and beverage industry, established in 1998.

Canonical website: https://www.behrizmobadel.com/
Primary language: Persian (fa-IR)
English section: https://www.behrizmobadel.com/en/

## Core expertise

- Beverage filtration system design: https://www.behrizmobadel.com/beverage-filtration.html
- Industrial juice and syrup filtration: https://www.behrizmobadel.com/juice-syrup-filtration.html
- Malt beverage filtration: https://www.behrizmobadel.com/malt-beverage-filtration.html
- Beverage production-line process equipment: https://www.behrizmobadel.com/beverage-production-line.html
- Industrial precoat candle filters: https://www.behrizmobadel.com/candle-filter.html
- Product portfolio: https://www.behrizmobadel.com/products.html

- Three-stage industrial filter for food-process oil, extract and syrup (Persian): https://www.behrizmobadel.com/three-stage-industrial-filter.html
- Three-stage industrial filter selection and RFQ guide (English): https://www.behrizmobadel.com/en/three-stage-industrial-filter.html
